title: Człowiek umiera na katar
description: Czesław leży w łóżku przekonany, że zwykłe przeziębienie jest śmiertelne.

prompts.image: Native vertical 9:16 late-1990s Polish television comedy. Exact Czeslaw lies propped high against floral pillows in a kitschy modest bedroom with pale floral wallpaper, lace-curtain window and warm bedside lamp. He wears striped button-up pajamas and black rectangular glasses. One real glass thermometer sits safely at one corner of his closed mouth. Patterned brown duvet rises toward camera; one crumpled tissue and burgundy hot-water bottle are visible. Camera near foot of bed, slightly low 40 mm lens. Exact photorealism, realistic pores and fabric, subtle 16 mm/S-VHS grain, cold window left and dirty warm lamp right. One person only, no text, no cigarette, no modern objects or AI artifacts.
prompts.animation: 2-second locked-off late-1990s TV shot. Czesław breathes heavily through his nose, blinks slowly and sinks one centimeter deeper into the pillow; the thermometer trembles slightly. Curtains move faintly. Keep his identity, glasses, pajamas, bed and room unchanged. No speech, cuts, new objects, morphing, text or watermark.
